'''ScragHull commando boats''' were vessels that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sarnus]], acting as the workhorses of the personnel employed at the [[Sarnus Refinery]]. In [[45 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who owned the Sarnus Refinery, gave a ScragHull to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] so that they could track down [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after he had been [[Firefight at the Blue Star casino|captured]] by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]]. They used the vessel to attack the Qrephs' [[asteroid crusher]], the ''[[Ormni]]'' and its complement of [[Bes'uliik]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. They also threatened to shoot down the Qrephs' [[Marcadian luxury cruiser]], the ''[[Aurel Moon]]'' with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], but let the craft escape when it became clear that Han Solo was on board the vessel.<ref name="C" />
